FireSpecs Changelog
===================

Version 4.0 (2026-06-03)
------------------------
* Added German and Russian localization
* Expanded Hardware info (CPU, GPU, Display)
* Added Intel GPU support
* Full Access mode via pkexec
* UI follows system theme; custom title bar on Wayland
* Many bug fixes and UI improvements

Version 3.0 (2026-02-14)
------------------------
* Added Matrix theme with terminal-style green/black colors
* Improved theme switching
* Minor bug fixes
* Wider compatibility
* Now open source!

Version 2.0 (2026-02-07)
------------------------
* Added Battery information to Hardware section
* Added USB device management with detach functionality
* Improved USB tab with numbering and actions
* Fixed table sizing and scrolling
* Updated About dialog

Version 1.0 (2025-01-01)
------------------------
* Initial release
